# useLinkComponentHookUsage - A custom Article card renders its title link with the component useLinkComponent resolves: the as prop first, then the nearest LinkProvider, then a native anchor. Inside a LinkProvider wired to a client-side router, the title navigates without a page load and updates the router location. With as="a" the title is a native anchor even inside the provider, and outside the provider it falls back to the next provider up or a native anchor.
# Components: Card, LinkComponent, LinkProvider
